description: Fork of exp603 (1.4295 SoTA). SINGLE change: out_proj tph per-layer schedule [2048, 2048, 1024, 1024, 1024, 1024] (heavy-early L0+L1, uniform 1024 elsewhere; NO taper). Direct port of project_outproj_per_layer_schedule.md's exp303 optimum, where L0+L1 boost was each worth ~-0.005 and tapering L4-L5 to 512 was sharply harmful (+0.015). exp604 (pyramid with taper) confirmed the taper hurts at exp603 scale too — ran +0.010 above exp603 by step 5400. This isolates the heavy-early lever. Total params 289.4M -> 339.7M (+50.35M); trunk 169 -> 194.2 Mbits (+25.2). Predicted -0.008 to -0.012 bpb at +0.5h wall-clock.
